newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells soft wheat, flour as food aid - ONIC.
newsitem.headline: France sells soft wheat, flour as food aid - ONIC.

text.p: France sold 4,000 tonnes of soft wheat grain for delivery to Nepal at 1,105.92 francs per tonne, fob Blaye, in a food aid tender it held on May 13, national grain office ONIC said.

Under the same tender France also sold 4,000 tonnes of soft wheat grain for delivery to Georgia at 1,145 francs per tonne, Fob Port La Nouvelle, and 730 tonnes of soft wheat flour for delivery to Sri Lanka at 1,660 francs per tonne, Fob Rouen.

France also sold 5,110 tonnes of soft wheat flour for delivery to Jordan, Lebanon, Syria and Israel under the U.N. Relief and Works Agency for Palestinian Refugees in the near Est (UNRWA) programme. The flour was sold at 1,731 francs per tonne, Fob Le Havre.
